column1: # faion UA->EN query lexicon - corpus data, not code.
# Format: ua_prefix<TAB>en_terms<TAB>src   (LF, no BOM, byte-sorted, NFC)
# ua_prefix is ONE lowercase Ukrainian token with its inflectional tail
# removed; the runtime does longest-prefix matching, so `kesh` covers
# kesh/keshu/keshem/keshuvannia. No stemmer is needed - one measured zero gain.
# src is provenance, re-derived by scripts/validate-lexicon.py:
#   taxonomy  ua_prefix is a prefix of a Ukrainian trigger word in
#   domains   every en term attested in skills/faion/knowledge/domains.xml
#   tags      every en term attested in meta.json tags
#   title     every en term attested in corpus slugs, paths, AGENTS.md titles
#   observed  at least one en term attested only in corpus body prose
# Expansion BOOSTS candidates; it never filters them.
